dialogue: Whoa! You've got 20 jars! Guess I worried for nothing.
I'll let you in, just be careful. It's a wonderful maze, but still a maze!
If you ever get lost, just start making all left turns, trust me.
Oh and I think it's clear, but watch out for [color=#36c5f4]glow worms[/color].
They can be a bit, well, hungry. If you get caught in their rope. Just uh, move quickly.
